lines.zh: 我走得像个人，直到你看见我。
lines.en: I walk like a person, until you see me.
My skin creases the moment I move.
Step by step, I copy it well.

lines.zh: 我从远处走过来，很自然。
lines.en: I come from a distance, quite naturally.

lines.zh: 我的脸在动的时候变形。
lines.en: My face warps when I move.
I walk with my head down, like a passerby.
My joints catch as I move.
I move along the wall, steps light.

lines.zh: 我走到一半，停下来看你。
lines.en: Halfway there, I stop and look at you.
I walk head-tilted, as if listening.
My hands hang too low.
I pause each step, as if waiting.
I stand still, like a normal person.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤有一块是空的。
lines.en: A patch of my skin is hollow.
I tilt my head at the wrong angle.
I am copying how you stand.
My mouth won't close.

lines.zh: 天花板上的我，倒着看你。
lines.en: From the ceiling, I watch you upside down.
There is a layer of dust on me.
I stand, long unmoving.
My shadow is not quite right.
I wait for someone to come near.
I stand like a post.
My eyes barely move.
I smell of soil.
My fingers tremble faintly.
It's me. Don't be afraid.
Do you know me?
Who do I look like?
Don't look at my face.
I was standing over there just now.
I raise a hand to greet you.
My hand is a little cold.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就明白了。
lines.en: You take a step back, and I understand.
I smile, and the skin splits.
I have been standing here all along.
What is your name?
You looked at me twice.
You walked past, then looked back.
My skin splits open.
I step back and drop my head.

lines.zh: 这一下让我露出了里面。
lines.en: That exposed what's inside.
I pull the skin straight, bit by bit.
My shoulder is off.
I pull the skin back.
I don't like this feeling.

lines.zh: 皮囊破了，里面才是真的我。
lines.en: The skin's torn now, and what's inside is the real me.
What are you holding?
I can smell that it is good.
Set it down and go.
I don't eat with my mouth.
That hand — keep it on your side.
That smell reminds me of something.
Anything left at the bottom of the bag?
Give it to me and I won't move.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的皮皱了一下。
lines.en: You bumped me and my skin creased.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把身体摆正。
lines.en: I give half a pace and right myself.
Sorry — I was standing in the way.
My shoulder is hard.

lines.zh: 我的影子和你叠在一起。
lines.en: My shadow overlaps yours.
I step aside to the wall.
We touched, and I went crooked.
Standing still, I look like a person.
This face is not mine.
Don't look too long.

lines.zh: 我在这条路边站了一天。
lines.en: I've stood by this road all day.

lines.zh: 我这副皮囊，不该靠这么近。
lines.en: This skin of mine shouldn't be this close.
I draw my hanging hands back.
I don't know what to say.
Go on. It's getting dark.

lines.zh: 天黑以后我就不一样了。
lines.en: After dark I am different.
I reach down and pick it up.

lines.zh: 这个不是我的，我放回地上。
lines.en: Not mine; I set it down.
I tuck it into a pocket.
I pick it up, my fingers bending backward.
Things on the ground, I take in passing.
It has some weight.
I squeeze it; it's soft.
I look, then put it down.
You dropped it? Here.
You kept standing there watching.
I knew you'd look back.
There is no one behind you.

lines.zh: 我把那张脸慢慢抬起来。
lines.en: I raise that face slowly.
My hands no longer hang.
You moved just now.
In this skin, I look like a person standing.
I haven't been like this in a long time.

lines.zh: 别喊了，这条巷子是空的。
lines.en: Stop shouting. This alley is empty.
I copy your steps and follow.
When you look back, there I am.
No hurry; I walk slowly.
My steps match yours.

lines.zh: 你数错巷子里的人影了。
lines.en: You miscounted the shadows in this alley.
I wait for you at the door.

lines.zh: 你数过这附近几个人吗。
lines.en: Have you counted the people near here?
My hand nearly reaches you.
You have backed to the wall.
Step by step.
Right at this alley corner.
I pull your collar down.
That looked very human.

lines.zh: 我的指节比正常人多一节。
lines.en: My knuckles have one joint too many.
I am stronger than I look.
You are dragged backward.

lines.zh: 我的手指比手掌长一截。
lines.en: My fingers run past my palm.
I bite your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别看了，这张脸从来不是我的。
lines.en: Stop staring. This face was never mine.
I stand by the road as if waiting.
There are few people here.
I straighten my clothes.
My skin is new.
I step out from behind the wall.
I learned a pose.
The lamp is at the far end of the street.
I start walking in.
My steps are steady.
There is room to stand a while.
I came around the far side of the wall.
I pat the dust off my clothes.
Fire rises and my skin curls.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，皮破了一大片。
lines.en: I fell and tore a large patch of skin.

lines.zh: 水泡着我，我的皮浮起来。
lines.en: Water soaks me and my skin floats.
Spell-light strips my disguise.
Too hungry to stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷光一照，谁都看得出我。
lines.en: In that flash, anyone could tell what I am.
The whole road beneath me is gone.
